# ===================================================================
# CALL HIERARCHY — ON-ACTION EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# On-actions are game engine hooks that fire events automatically.
# Use Call Hierarchy (Shift+Alt+H) on an on-action name to see:
#   Incoming: (on-actions are triggered by the game engine, not script)
#   Outgoing: Which events are listed in the events block
#
# Cross-references:
#   on_yearly_pulse — fires adventure.0001
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# on_yearly_pulse
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: (game engine — no script callers)
# OUTGOING CALLS: adventure.0001
#
# This on-action fires adventure.0001 once per year for eligible
# characters. In Call Hierarchy, adventure.0001's incoming calls
# should include this on-action.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
on_yearly_pulse = {
	events = {
		adventure.0001
	}
}
